response.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg), g AS (SELECT mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM base GROUP BY mix), s AS (SELECT mix, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER ()) OVER () AS avg_share FROM g) SELECT mix, cnt, share, share - avg_share AS diff_above_avg FROM s WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC
